warning.titlePre: Jaguar XF 5.0 V8 (AJ133) Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The AJ133 / AJ133S is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ133 / AJ133S V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ133 / AJ133S rebuild.
Because the XF 5.0 V8 (AJ133) uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the XF 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established AJ133 / AJ133S specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
